about:
Synergy Industrial Corporation operates a retail store in Brookfield, Wisconsin, at 3540 North 126th Street. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business sells consumer goods including appliances, televisions, computers, home goods, and toys. Inventory consists of open-box, new overstock, and refurbished items that are inspected before sale. Synergy also buys, sells, and repairs hard drives of any capacity or condition. The facility includes a showroom and warehouse space in Unit M, though square footage and headcount are not specified. The store operates Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.

Customers are primarily walk-in shoppers and online buyers through the company’s eBay store. No specific industrial or commercial accounts are mentioned in the available information.

The company emphasizes a commitment to providing options for every budget and preference, with quality standards applied to refurbished stock. It cites ISO certification as a quality marker, though the specific standard is not named.
